insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options: 3L, 4L, 5L, 7.5L, 10L, 12.5L, 15L, 20L, 25L, 50L, 75L, 100L (Individual/Family Floater); Total SI may include Booster Benefit and optional Safeguard/Safeguard+; plus ReAssure benefit

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: ReAssure Unlimited reinstatement up to base Sum Insured. (Applicable for both same & different illness)
great.explanation: You get unlimited reinstatements of your base Sum Insured for the same or different illnesses within the policy year. This means your coverage can be fully replenished multiple times, providing excellent protection for multiple claims.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: The sequence of utilization of Sum Insured will be as below: i. Base Sum Insured ... iii. Accumulated Cumulative Bonus under Booster benefit (if any) followed by; iv. ReAssure benefit
great.explanation: An additional Sum Insured layer called ReAssure activates after your base Sum Insured and bonuses are used up. This gives you extra financial protection during the policy year for multiple claims.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy .
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage. This waiting period is standard in the market.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Listed diseases and procedures are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage. This waiting period aligns with typical market standards.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days except accidents, which are covered immediately. This is a common industry practice.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay above mentioned Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 60 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered. This duration is considered good and standard.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for up to 180 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered, which is at the higher end of standard coverage periods.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote:
Annexure II - The expenses that are not covered or subsumed into room charges / procedure charges / costs of treatment
List  I – Expenses not covered ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 57 NEBULISATION KIT ...
bad.reference: Annexure II (List I – Expenses not covered)
bad.explanation: Common consumables like gloves, masks, and nebulisation kits are excluded from coverage. This means you may have to pay for these items out-of-pocket during hospitalization.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-payment (if applicable) as specified in the Policy Schedule shall be applicable on the amount payable by Us.
bad.explanation: Co-pay may apply as per the Policy Schedule, but the exact percentage or conditions are not stated here. Verify your Policy Schedule to know if and when co-pay applies.

unclear.name: Room Rent
unclear.quote: Room Rent means the amount charged by a Hospital towards Room and Boarding expenses and shall include the associated medical expenses.
unclear.reference: Section 3.1.41 (Room Rent) + Annexure I (Inpatient Care: 'Covered up to Sum Insured')
unclear.explanation: The policy does not specify the eligible room category or any limit on room rent. You should check your Policy Schedule to confirm your room entitlement and avoid unexpected deductions.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
